test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All computers are boxes.

All boxes are printers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All printers are computers.

II. All computers are printers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e8339dd092e3bbfd6ad66a45d6a2db4a9bf97a55404001bf5376d94349eeedd.png] 

**Conclusions:**

1) All Printers are Computers → Does not follow (Some part of Printers may be a Computer but, All Printers may not be a complete Computer).

2) All Computers are Printers → Follows (Cleary mention in Venn Diagram that Computer is complete part of Printers).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
